H ![](https://integrations.sh/logo/helpscout.com)

Help Scout exposes HTTP APIs for Docs, Inbox, Chat, and Apps/Beacon integrations plus Beacon mobile SDKs; recorded auth is Docs API key over Basic auth, OAuth Bearer token for Chat, app secret for signed app callbacks, and a Beacon secure-mode secret, while Inbox and some Beacon surfaces remain auth-undetermined.

discovered 4mo ago

REST · OpenAPI5

Credentials

Docs API keyapi_key[Get key ↗](https://developer.helpscout.com/docs-api/)

In your Help Scout account, click the profile/person icon, open **Your Profile**, then go to **Authentication** → **API Keys** to generate, view, or regenerate your Docs API key. If you do not see an API key, an account owner or administrator must grant the **Docs: Create new, edit settings & Collections** permission first. See [Docs API Overview](https://developer.helpscout.com/docs-api/).

Help Scout OAuth appoauth2[Set up OAuth ↗](https://developer.helpscout.com/apps/getting-started/)

Log in to Help Scout as an administrator or account owner, go to **Manage > Apps**, click **Create**, then **Create App**, and complete the form for your app. Use the app's credentials to obtain OAuth access tokens for Help Scout APIs. Help Scout's app setup flow is described in [Apps Getting Started](https://developer.helpscout.com/apps/getting-started/), and API requests shown in the Chat API docs use `Authorization: Bearer oauth_token` in [Chat API endpoint docs](https://developer.helpscout.com/chat/endpoints/get/).

Help Scout App secret keyapi_key[Get key ↗](https://developer.helpscout.com/apps/getting-started/)

Create a Help Scout App in **Manage > Apps** → **Create** → **Create App**, then set the **Secret Key** field in the app form. Help Scout includes an `X-HelpScout-Signature` query parameter on requests to your app callback URLs, and you use this shared secret to verify the signature as described in [Signature Validation](https://developer.helpscout.com/apps/guides/signature-validation/).
